title: Miseform recipe card data
description: Machine-readable form of the recipe-card field contract in references/schema.md#recipe-card-field-contract. One document is the single source for the HTML reading edition, the PDF export and the Excel export, so both exports carry the same recipe ID, version, date, status, quantities, percentage bases, steps, controls and blockers.

recipe_id.description: Stable existing library recipe ID or a unique provisional ID such as TEMP-YYYYMMDD-<token>.

version.description: Semantic version for a new record. Legacy source versions stay verbatim in provenance.

revision_date.description: Kitchen-confirmed date basis for this revision.

release_blockers.description: Visible unresolved issues. Required and non-empty unless status is PRODUCTION.

library_name.description: Library root name as it should appear on the card.

intro.description: Short supported introduction: target flavor/texture, service role, consequential technique.

facts.description: The four-card facts strip. Each slot maps to one cell of the facts strip, so keep the strong slot short and put the supporting detail in the plain slot.

difficulty_level.description: Short confirmed level, for example Basic or Advanced.

difficulty_technique.description: The skill or technique that warrants the level.

storage_summary.description: Approved rule summary, or a conspicuous pending status.

storage_reference.description: Approved SOP reference, or why it is unresolved.

equipment.description: Appliance/model where consequential, capacity, load, vessel, scale resolution, probe.

allergens.description: Intentional allergens, label verification evidence, cross-contact controls. No unsupported free-from claim.

basis_label.description: Human statement of the reference ingredient, its preparation state and its mass.

reference_row_id.description: Row ID of the reference ingredient, when the card-level basis names one ingredient row.

process_controls.description: Controlled parameters for each applicable process, per references/schema.md#process-controls. A process that does not apply states N/A with the reason. The eight keys are the eight processes named in references/schema.md#process-controls.

labeling.description: Label content for an item that is stored or transferred. Required by references/validation.md#recipe-completeness when the card states how the product is held. An unresolved value is NEEDS CHEF CONFIRMATION, never a plausible default.

components.description: Independently scaled components. Each names its own percentage reference.

reference_row_id.description: Row ID inside this component that is 100% for this component.

reference_weight_g.description: Mass of the reference row, in grams. Must equal that row's weight_g.

weight_g.description: Net weight in grams at the stated preparation state.

volume.description: Measured or source-supported volume with its unit, or null for unknown. Never a fabricated conversion.

input_total_g.description: Sum of all ingredient weights. Water used in cooking is not finished yield.

usable_yield_g.description: Measured usable output mass. Null when never measured; never an estimate presented as measured.

loss_g.description: Input minus usable output, when both are known.

portions.description: Complete portions. Computed as floor(usable_yield_g / portion_g); the remainder stays recorded.

stages.description: Chronological stages. Step numbers continue across stages.

ingredient_refs.description: Row IDs used in this step.

settings.description: Equipment settings used by this step: speed/rpm, mode, humidity, fan, pressure, heat level. Recorded with the step that uses them, not only in the equipment list.

notes.description: Operational note blocks: service, holding/storage, scaling, controls, substitutions.

release_checklist.description: Unresolved blocker or required verification shown in the release block.

batch_factor.description: Default scaling factor offered on the Batch Scaling sheet.

tested_batch_range.description: Batch range actually tested. Factors outside it need a trial.
